en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Every time I come here, I play the
role of their "ideal." Like some shared fantasy.

<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of fantasy
does Tsumugi have...?
Hey, Sweetchi.
..."Sweetchi"?

Hm? Would you prefer I 
called you "big brother"?

Well I don't wanna. You don't wanna 
call me little sister, do you Sweetchi?

<CLT=cltMIND>Big brother?
Little sister?

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah...
What is going on here...?

Don't be nervous...I'll still call you 
big brother in front of mom and dad.

If they found out about us, 
I wouldn't be able to be with you.

Aaah...it's just like some story 
from a light novel.

Our parents remarried and I got a 
brother and...I fell in love with him.
What...?

I never thought that plain old me 
would be in such a flashy role.

It's perfect...just like the big 
brother route in a dating sim.

Or I guess it's more like the little 
sister route for you, huh Sweetchi?

<CLT=cltMIND>I see...so that's what's going on.
It fits Tsumugi, but it's a little...heavy.

But I don't like you just because 
you're my big brother, Sweetchi...

Falling in love with someone who just 
happened to be your sibling...

It's a popular cliche, but to think 
I'd end up experiencing it myself...
Tsumugi...
Aww, don't call me that, Sweetchi...

If we're lovers, we should have 
nicknames for each other, right?
Ah...sorry.
No, I'm sorry...

I feel...off today. It's plain to see I'm 
being negative. What's gotten into me?

Times like this, I need you to 
cheer me up, Sweetchi...
Cheer you up...how?

Huh? Don't ask me! I don't have enough 
experience in this sort of thing!

Umm...so, how about you...
put your hand on my cheek?
Ah, alright...I can do that...

<CLT=cltMIND>Just as I was told, I cupped
Tsumugi's cheek in my palm.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi sighed and covered
my hand with hers...

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah... Ah!
This is so embarrassing!
Aaah...

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi released a deep breath and watched
me closely through her glasses.

<CLT=cltMIND>It was such a seductive gaze...
I almost forgot to breathe.

Your hands...are surprisingly big,
Sweetchi.
Ah, y-you think so...?

Hmm? What's wrong? It's plain 
to see you're embarrassed.

It's just that, when you say things like
that...it feels as though we're real lovers.
You don't think we're real lovers?

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi's countenance shifted to
a look of foul scorn.

So...you can't see me as anything 
more than your little sister?

Are you just humoring your silly little
sister by pretending to be her lover?
N-No, that's not it...

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi's expression was inscrutable.
She pulled my hand off her cheek, then...
W-W-Whoa!
Mmm...

<CLT=cltMIND>slid my finger into her
mouth and started sucking it!
Wh-Wh-What are you doing!?

<CLT=cltMIND>I lost my composure completely
and yanked my finger from her mouth.

<CLT=cltMIND>I tried not to think about the fading warmth,
the saliva cooling as it dried, lingering...
Haha... Was that...a little too bold?

But if I didn't take it that far, 
you wouldn't realize...
Realize...what?
I want you...to make me your real lover.
Wh-What...?

I want to become one with you...
I want us to feel everything together...

<CLT=cltMIND>She batted her eyelashes at me in a
way that was impossible to misinterpret.

<CLT=cltMIND>Her eyes, her lips, her body...
They begged me to take her.
I...like you, Sweetchi.

If I ignored these feelings just 
because we're siblings...

I'd regret it the rest of my life...
That's...how much I like you.

<CLT=cltMIND>Her lips a smile,
she sauntered toward me.

<CLT=cltMIND>She spoke slowly, letting
every syllable sink in.
I love you, Sweetchi...

<CLT=cltMIND>I felt like her voice had wrapped
around my brain, caressing it.

<CLT=cltMIND>I couldn't help it...
She had me.
<CLT=cltMIND>.........
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme, "Love Suite."
